actions.tooltip: Local: build \\r -> runReader ma (f r). The outer caller still supplies the original r; only ma sees f(r).

objects.tooltip: f : r ⟶ r — environment transformer (e.g. add a key, strip a layer, swap config).
ma : Reader r a — the inner reader to be run with the transformed environment.
Reader r a — same outer signature, but executions of ma are scoped to the transformed environment.
